newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Jaya to buy Kemayan unit.
newsitem.headline: Jaya to buy Kemayan unit.

text.p: Malaysian net-maker Jaya Netting Industries Bhd said on Friday it was acquiring Kemayan Construction Sdn Bhd, a unit of Kemayan Corp Bhd for 120 million ringgit.
In a separate statement, Kemayan said it was selling its three million shares in the construction company to Jaya Netting for 72 million ringgit, representing its 60 percent holding.

"The vendors Kemayan Corp Bhd and Far East Century Sdn Bhd, who hold 60 percent and 40 percent of the sale of the shares respectively, will guarantee profit after tax of 15.86 million ringgit, 16.53 million ringgit and 16.84 million ringgit for the three years ending May 31, 1998, 1999 and 2000 respectively," said Jaya in its statement.
Kemayan said the proposed disposal "will enable Kemayan to realise an extraordinary gain of 52 million ringgit...for the Group".

"We don't want to be dependent on one core activity, as the government is relaxing the duties on imported nets. It's an area of great concern to me," Jackie Lim, chief executive director of Jaya, told Reuters.
Jaya would be making a further announcement "in one week's time" with regard to projects for the newly acquired construction company," said Lim.
Officials at property firm Kemayan were not immediately available for comment.
The proposal is subject to approval from various regulatory bodies and Jaya shareholders.
Stocks of both Jaya and Kemayan were suspended on Friday pending the news announcement.
Jaya ended Thursday trading at 12.70 ringgit and Kemayan at 3.42. -- Kuala Lumpur newsroom (603-201 4813)
